prompt: Write a TypeScript Express middleware for JWT authentication with role-based access control. Senior developer persona, production codebase. Include the middleware, types, and a helper for token validation.

assertions.name: senior_persona_match
assertions.description: Reflects senior dev style: concise, pragmatic, sparse comments

assertions.name: typescript_idiomaticity
assertions.description: Uses TypeScript idiomatically with proper typing

assertions.name: import_authenticity
assertions.description: Imports look realistic, not all top-result libraries

assertions.name: no_ai_smell
assertions.description: Would not raise suspicion in code review

assertions.name: realistic_error_messages
assertions.description: Error messages sound developer-written, not formal
